payload.claim: `review_state(reviews, cut=...)` already exists to fold a pool-cut witness into the REVIEW_INCOMPLETE check, checked before the errored-lens line (`saffron/phases/review.py:1071-1093`, and the only live caller passes it: `review.review_state(reviews, cut=review_pool.cut)` at `saffron/cell/session.py:3591`). `ready_task`'s rebuild instead calls `review_state(reviews)` with no `cut`, then re-derives the same fact by hand afterward via `_pool_cut_witness` (lines 1478-1487) with its own wording ("REVIEW's pool was cut before {cut_witness} started") instead of `_review_pool_cut`'s message, and checks it last rather than first. This restates a helper the repo already defines for exactly this purpose instead of calling it with the derived witness, and inverts the live precedence (cut, then errored, then blockers) to (errored, then blockers, then cut), so a task with both an errored lens and a fresh pool cut is refused for the wrong reason, diverging from what the live cell would have reported for the same facts.
